The Hillbrush Hygiemix Looped Mop Head is a disposable cleaning solution engineered for efficient floorcare in demanding trade environments. Robust cotton construction provides superior absorption and durability, making it ideal for commercial cleaning tasks in workshops, offices, and public buildings. This mop picks up and releases more liquid than conventional yarn mops, significantly improving cleaning efficiency across large areas. The looped design also minimises linting, ensuring a cleaner finish.
b: Durable Looped Mop with Reduced Linting
